verdict.rationale: First-party docs state incidents can be declared in seconds directly from Slack or Microsoft Teams. Other docs refer to a dedicated incident channel receiving updates, an auto-started Teams meeting per incident, and AI Suggestions that draft updates and summaries from incident activity, so the core chat-driven declare-and-run flow is covered. Missing for 10: any evidence of incident roles being assigned or created, explicit documentation that the channel is created automatically on declaration (it is only implied), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
